scope: two initial continuous raw T1 complete reconstructions after all mandatory component and installation gates; no stage restart or reference reuse
case_selection: two already verified members of unchanged frozen ten-case cohort; other eight not located in registered accelerator-b inputs; no case replaced after outcomes
case_order: sequential, same physical GPU and CPU affinity for both; no concurrent cases

requested_recipe.precision: FP32/TF32 with existing verified FP32 exceptions

failure_policy: report exact phase/traceback hash and exit; no original-program fallback, no subject replacement, preserve attempt, no silent stage resume counted as continuous whole

timing.outer_start: before spawning fresh installed CLI process, includes interpreter startup and imports
timing.outer_stop: process exit, report/138-output writes, all descendants reaped and publish/cleanup finished
required_metrics: each complete stage wall including I/O and sync
substep function and target synchronization waits
timing.cold_and_warm: record real import/JIT/cache/allocator state; no synthesized cold label; compare same cache condition
timing.stable_speed_claim: no single-pair causal claim in shared hardware

precision_and_gpu_monitor.precision_record: parent/worker actual TF32 and autocast at entry/exit plus actual floating dtype, target UUID and allocator state; API restoration checked separately
precision_and_gpu_monitor.device_total_and_compute_process_sum: separate sampled upper observations, include unrelated tasks; cannot be task memory
precision_and_gpu_monitor.sampling_limit: sampled peak may miss transient peaks; include maximum interval, failed samples and ownership completeness; no0-for-missing
precision_and_gpu_monitor.nested_profiler: target-device synchronization only when profiling enabled, do not reset outer peak

production_io_boundary.allowed: raw T1, own empty output, verified fixed resources, installed Python/generic libraries
production_io_boundary.denied: original stage executables/libraries, official subjects/results, legacy frozen stage inputs, old run directories
production_io_boundary.audit_scope: Python direct program guard plus inherited workers; full file/library access isolation needs independent OS-level proof, guard alone insufficient
production_io_boundary.reference: independent comparison only after producer exit; do not expose official results to producer

acceptance.precision_reference: reuse existing original-software FP32 evidence only when same input/resource/algorithm versions bound; never relabel early v2/v3 incomplete EM outputs
acceptance.private_brain_QC: required, report hashes publicly; images remain private
acceptance.ten_case_acceptance: not established by first two or by preparation

outputs_export: typed scalar/hash/provenance only; paths, logs, images and resources private
